definitions.explanation: A demonstrative adjective used before nouns to indicate something close to the listener or previously mentioned.

examples.japanese: その{本|ほん}を{貸|か}してください。
その{話|はなし}は{本当|ほんとう}ですか。
その{時|とき}、{電話|でんわ}が{鳴|な}りました。
examples.english: At that time, the phone rang.

notes: その modifies nouns and must be followed by a noun. It refers to things near the listener or to previously mentioned information. その{時|とき} (at that time), その{後|あと} (after that), and その{他|ほか} (others, the rest) are common expressions.
